dependency_reconciliation.explanation: Two distinct installations have matching selected RECORD hashes. Distribution enumeration collapses duplicate torch names with last value 2.1.1; first-match metadata and the post-run import identify 2.13.0+cu130. All Torch worker runtime version receipts must match the latter.
dependency_reconciliation.scope: Worker version receipts and post-run installation identity only. No retrospective hash of Torch binaries loaded by workers is available; the post-run _C hash does not establish that identity.

policy.purpose: Complete descriptive fixed-workload timings; full-PSD failures remain failures.
policy.change: After observing excluded-bin PSD differences, allow timings only after all corrected-baseline and proposed-backend trigger comparisons, exact conditioned strain/geometry, and exact used PSD bins pass. Preserve full-array checks and prohibit full-equivalence speedup claims. No source, input, tolerance, worker command or ordering changes.

receipt.scope: All acquired tracked-file hashes match local Git objects at the measured commits, resolving tracked symlink targets inside the Git archive to match acquisition hashing. Native binary and generated-version identities remain recorded acquisition/build evidence, not Git-tracked source.

provenance_scope: Transferred files were hash-checked where present. Untransferred source/input bytes are supported only by pinned acquisition receipts; no remote source reconstruction or live-runtime inspection is claimed. Conditioned strain equality uses recorded digests and metadata; the strain samples were not stored by acquisition.
